description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- ETHSafari is marking its fifth anniversary this year, celebrating its growth into one of Africa's leading blockchain gatherings connecting the continent's developers, entrepreneurs and communities with the global Web3 ecosystem.
title: Africa: Ethsafari Marks Five Years Connecting Africa to Global Blockchain Ecosystem

description: [Independent (Kampala)] Africa has no shortage of evidence that polluted air is harming people's health, slowing economic growth and placing an increasing burden on cities already grappling with rapid urbanisation. What the continent lacks, experts say, is the investment and political resolve to turn that evidence into cleaner skies.
title: Africa: The Cost of Dirty Air, and Africa's Search for Solutions

description: [ISS] The 17 August meeting in Durban should turn shared history and economic interdependence into coordinated action against xenophobia.
title: Africa: SADC's 2026 Summit Must Tackle Migration Head-On

description: [Daba Finance] Dangote Petroleum Refinery has filed an initial public offering application with Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission, moving the company closer to a listing on the Nigerian Exchange. SEC Director-General Emomotimi Agama said the refinery's advisers are working with the regulator and that the company is targeting September 2026. No offer or listing date has been approved.
title: Africa: Africa's Biggest IPO Nears As Dangote Refinery Files for Listing
Africa: All of Africa Today - August 4, 2026

description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- More than half of all cybercrimes reported across Africa are now AI-enabled, the International Criminal Police Organization (INTERPOL) has revealed, warning that digital attacks have rapidly evolved into an industrialized, borderless ecosystem that is becoming increasingly difficult to detect and combat.
title: Africa: Over Half of Africa's Cybercrimes Are AI-Enabled - Interpol

description: [Parliament of South Africa] The Speaker of the National Assembly, Ms Thoko Didiza, has called for stronger parliamentary cooperation across the African continent to advance Africa's Agenda 2063. She was addressing the opening of the 26th Conference of Speakers of National and Regional Parliaments convened under the auspices of the Pan-African Parliament (PAP) in Midrand.
title: Africa: Speaker Calls for Stronger Parliamentary Cooperation to Advance Africa's Agenda 2063

description: [Leadership] The Economic Community of West African States Regional Competition Authority (ECOWAS-ERCA) has warned that price-fixing, market allocation and anti-competitive practices were undermining economic integration and driving up the cost of goods across West Africa.
title: West Africa: Market Cartels Undermining West Africa's Economy - ECOWAS

description: [UN News] Breastfeeding rates are rising worldwide, but millions of mothers and families still lack the services and protection they need to feed their babies safely, the UN has warned.
title: Africa: Mothers Still Lack Support to Breastfeed, UN Warns
